title: Initiative Velocity Orthogonality Matrix and Escalation Slate
creator: Asha Ramaswamy
description:
Summary:
We need a pragmatic, operational model to translate company OKRs into prioritized, cross-functional initiatives that are actionable for teams and responsive to capacity signals. This ticket scopes the 'Initiative Velocity Orthogonality Matrix' (IVOM) and an 'Escalation Slate' — together a lightweight decisioning surface for PMs, Eng leads, and GTM to sequence work, detect orthogonal workstreams, and escalate conflicts when capacity or dependencies threaten OKR delivery.

Background / Problem:
- Current roadmap artifacts and OKR mappings are verbose and subjective: conflicting priorities reappear in weekly syncs.
- Teams double-booked on shared infra and runtime work (e.g., Dedicated capacity, console telemetry) cause hidden velocity hits that aren't surfaced to execs until late.
- The company needs a repeatable mechanism to: 1) quantify orthogonality (how much two initiatives consume the same scarce resources), 2) bucket initiatives by realistic velocity given resource signals, and 3) provide an escalation path when trade-offs are required.

Goals (non-exhaustive):
- Define metrics and a simple scoring model for Initiative Orthogonality and Initiative Velocity (score ranges and thresholds).
- Produce an operational artifact (matrix + slate) that can be updated each cycle and visualized in the Console roadmap view and an internal dashboard.
- Reduce cross-team delivery conflicts classified as "late dependency resolution" by 50% for the Q1 roadmap slice.
- Ensure PMs can make prioritization calls with quantified trade-offs and a documented escalation record.

Proposed approach:
1) Design the IVOM schema: initiative-id, primary owner, secondary owners, resource vectors (e.g., GPU-hours, infra-engineer-days, data-science-effort), orthogonality score (0-100), velocity bucket (A: high, B: medium, C: low), confidence band (high/med/low).
2) Define a short questionnaire for owners to populate during planning (7 fields, takes <10 mins).
3) Create a lightweight scoring script (spreadsheet + python sample) to compute orthogonality and velocity buckets using historical cycle data (past 6 months).
4) Generate the first IVOM for company OKRs (top 12 initiatives) and publish as the canonical prioritization artifact for the cycle.
5) Build an "Escalation Slate": a rolling list with one-line trade-offs, recommended mitigation path, decision owner, and target decision date. Integrate it into PM sync and escalation runbook.

Deliverables:
- IVOM template (Google Sheets + CSV export)
- Scoring script and example dataset (GitHub gist)
- Escalation Slate template in Confluence and a one-click link from roadmap doc
- Dashboard mock in Looker/Metabase showing orthogonality heatmap + velocity buckets
- Playbook: how to run the model each cycle and who signs the decisions

Acceptance criteria:
- IVOM populated for at least 12 company-level initiatives with sources documented.
- Scoring script validated with two retrospective cycles and reproduceable outputs.
- Escalation Slate contains at least 5 entries (anticipated conflicts) with owners and target decision dates.
- PM Sync uses the IVOM as the decision input at least twice during the cycle.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Owners under-report resource usage. Mitigation: add validation step where Eng leads confirm resource vectors before IVOM is accepted.
- Risk: Score complexity undermines adoption. Mitigation: keep initial score linear and explainable; reserve complex models for v2.

Stakeholders:
- Leads: VP Product (Maya Chen), Head of Engineering (Ravi Kapoor), Head of Platform (Evelyn Park)
- Primary owners: PMs for the mapped initiatives, Eng leads for infra/shared services
- Consumers: Execs for trade-off decisions, Program Management for tracking

Timeline:
- 2025-02-10: Kickoff and template draft (this ticket)
- 2025-02-14: Internal review with Eng + Design
- 2025-02-18: Populate IVOM for top 12 initiatives (first pass)
- 2025-02-21: Publish Escalation Slate + run PM Sync walkthrough
- 2025-02-28: Finalize dashboard mock and handoff to Analytics for implementation

acceptance_criteria: IVOM populated for 12 initiatives with owner-confirmed resource vectors
Scoring script reproduces IVOM outputs for two retrospective cycles
Escalation Slate contains owners and target decision dates for all listed conflicts
IVOM referenced in 2 PM Syncs during cycle
decisions: Use a simple additive orthogonality scoring model for v1 (sum of normalized resource overlaps)
Velocity bucket thresholds: A >= 70, B 40-69, C < 40
Escalation Slate routed to execs for conflicts with orthogonality >80 AND velocity bucket A for secondary owner
